positioning: Continuous discovery and ownership mapping of autonomous AI agents and their MCP server connections, closing the visibility gap left by EDR/CSPM tools that focus on traditional workloads.
coreFeatures: Agent inventory with ownership attribution across cloud, SaaS, and on-prem
MCP server connection monitoring and risk scoring
Drift detection between approved agent registry and running instances
differentiators: Purpose-built for autonomous AI agents, not generic processes or containers
Maps agent-to-MCP-server relationships and data flows
LangGraph-native telemetry for agent orchestration visibility
mvpBuildPlan: Deploy sensorless discovery via cloud APIs and identity providers
Correlate agent identities with MCP server endpoints using OpenTelemetry
Build dashboard showing unowned agents and unauthorized MCP connections
risks: EDR/CSPM vendors adding agent discovery modules
Enterprise reluctance to deploy new sensors for AI workloads
MCP standard evolution breaking connection parsing
productName: Opsin Security AI agent visibility platform
valueProposition: Reveals the gap between reported AI inventory and actual running agents, providing visibility into agent ownership, deployment without security review, and unauthorized MCP server connections that create unmanaged attack surfaces.
